//===== Ragnarok Offline =====================================
//= Black-Market Armor Seller
//= Mordain offers body armor in Equipment catalogs.
//= Browse by 0-9 or A-Z using stripped client display names only.
//============================================================

paramk,37,163,2	script	Mordain#offline	4_EP21_GALAXIA_A,{
	mes "[Mordain]";
	mes "Body armor, sorted for the discerning knight.";
	.@shop$ = "";
		.@letter = select("A-H:I-P:Q-Z / 0-9") - 1;
		if (.@letter == 0) .@shop$ = "arm0#AH";
		else if (.@letter == 1) .@shop$ = "arm0#IP";
		else if (.@letter == 2) .@shop$ = "arm0#QZ9";
		if (.@shop$ == "") { close; }
	callfunc "F_BlackMarketDailyRemark", "Mordain", $BlackMarketRateMordain;
	close2;
	callblackmarketshop .@shop$, 1, $BlackMarketRateMordain;
	end;

OnInit:
	setunittitle(getnpcid(0), "<Dark Knight>");
	end;
}
